title: Quminex Raises $1.5M CAD ($1.06M USD) Pre-Seed Round Led by Quantacet and QAI Ventures to Advance Mineral Discovery Platform - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quebec's Quminex raised a C$1.5M (~US$1.06M) pre-seed round led by Quantacet with QAI Ventures to commercialize its ML and HPC-based critical-mineral discovery platform, and signed its first commercial contracts with Tech-X Resources and a mid-tier Canadian producer. Despite appearing in a quantum outlet, the text describes machine learning and high-performance computing, not quantum methods.

insights.claim: Quminex raised $1.5M CAD (~$1.06M USD) in a pre-seed round led by deep-tech VC Quantacet, with Swiss-based QAI Ventures and angel investors participating.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: This is a small round, but quantum-focused VCs are funding classical ML applications adjacent to quantum.

insights.claim: Quminex says early-stage mineral exploration relies heavily on subjective expert judgment applied to sparse, fragmented geological data, which leads to high capital risk and long timelines.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Data-driven targeting could reduce exploration capex risk, and that inefficiency is the value pool for AI exploration tools.
insights.quote: Early-stage mineral exploration traditionally relies heavily on subjective expert judgment applied to sparse, fragmented geological data

insights.claim: The Quminex Discovery Platform turns geochemical, geophysical and spatial datasets into explainable, testable mineral system models using proprietary machine learning, feature engineering and high-performance computing. The text does not describe any quantum method.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Treat Quminex as a critical-minerals AI play rather than quantum exposure.

themes.theme: Traction and a prospector-style business model

insights.claim: Quminex completed its first commercial contracts with private explorer Tech-X Resources Inc. and a mid-tier Canadian mining producer, validating its modeling stack on active properties.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Early paying customers lower technology risk, but the size of the contracts is not disclosed.
insights.locator: In tandem with the capital raise

insights.claim: Quminex will use the capital to expand its team, scale its algorithms and directly acquire exploration licenses across Canadian jurisdictions, building its own portfolio of high-probability targets.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Moving from software vendor to license holder gives Quminex upside if a discovery is made, a prospect-generator model tied to the critical-minerals supply-security theme.
